mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_task (user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{content}, #{result,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, #{errorMessage}, NOW(), NOW(), #{completedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_task SET user_id = #{userId}, session_id = #{sessionId}, task_type = #{taskType}, status = #{status}, content = #{content}, result = #{result,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW(), completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, task_type, status, content, result, error_message, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM memory_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' OR status = 'PROCESSING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
